description: This Scala source file defines classes related to building and filtering Spark event filters, specifically for tracking live jobs, stages, tasks, executors, and filtering events based on their status within Spark's deployment history module.

classes.name: BasicEventFilterBuilder
classes.description: Builds and maintains live job, stage, task, executor states and creates event filters to reject finished jobs and dead executors.

classes.name: JobEventFilter
classes.description: Abstract class providing filtering logic for job-related Spark events based on live job, stage, task, and RDD states.

classes.name: BasicEventFilter
classes.description: Concrete class extending JobEventFilter to filter events related to finished jobs or dead executors, based on current live states.

methods.name: createFilter
methods.description: Creates an EventFilter instance based on current live job, stage, task, RDD, and executor states.

methods.name: acceptFn
methods.description: Returns a partial function to accept or reject SparkListenerEvent based on executor and block manager states.
